slides.title: Linkers of contrast, cause and result
slides.subtitle: Connecting ideas clearly
goals: Express contrast: **however, although, even though, despite**.
Express cause: **because, because of, since, as**.
Express result: **so, therefore, as a result**.

errors.bad: Despite it was raining, we went out.
errors.good: **Although** it was raining, we went out. / **Despite the rain**, we went out.
**Because** it was late… / **Because of** the time…

items.q: ___ the traffic, we arrived on time.
The shop was closed, ___ we went home.
The flight was cancelled ___ the storm.

items.t: ___ she was tired, she kept working.
Prices went up. ___, sales fell. (resultado, formal)
